title: Platform Engineer (Backend Infrastructure)
description:
Position: Infrastructure Engineer
Location: Poland/Europe - Remote
Type: This can be structured as a B2B contract or Employment Contract with full benefits
Poland B2B Annual Rate: $102,000 - $117,500 depending on experience + stock options
Portugal Salary Band: €60,000 - €72,000 depending on experience + stock options
## Who We Are
Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are a Silicon Valley-based startup headquartered in San Francisco, with operations in Canada, the UK, multiple EU countries and a tech hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning-first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world, processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of stores globally.
We were recently named Confluent's inaugural Data Streaming Startup of the Year, a recognition of how seriously we take the engineering challenges at the core of our business.
We seek smart, creative, and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company.
## What We're Looking For
We are looking for a Platform Engineer to own the platform that every image from every store passes through: ingestion, Kafka streaming, Python services, GPU model inference, databases, storage, and the GCP and Kubernetes layer underneath. The team is small, so there is no separate SRE, DBA or release team. When a pipeline slows down, you find out whether the cause is a Kafka consumer, a MySQL query, an autoscaler or a node pool, and you fix it, including in the application code. The role is cloud-only, with no on-prem or datacenter hardware, and CI/CD pipelines are a small part of it.
The core challenge is scale. We are processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of retail locations globally, and that number is growing fast. Load will grow by an order of magnitude, and your job is to make sure cost and operational effort do not grow with it.
## What You Will Do
• Own the design, operation and cost of Focal's production platform on GCP: Kubernetes, Kafka, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, object storage.
• Drive measurable reductions in COGS and latency, for example lowering GPU inference cost per store through machine types, batching, autoscaling or scheduling, and report the numbers.
• Read, debug and change Python (FastAPI, Kafka consumers) backend services. Platform problems are often fixed in application code, for example a MySQL query that ran fine at 1,000 stores and times out at 10,000.
• Fix throughput bottlenecks such as consumer lag at store opening, whether the cause is partition count, consumer throughput, a downstream database or autoscaling reaction time.
• Rework metrics, alerts and dashboards so the on-call engineer can tell which stores and regions are affected when an alert fires. Take part in incident response, postmortems and capacity planning.
• Build tooling that gives engineers access to data across regions and storage systems in minutes instead of days.
• Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm) and the deployment path to production, and work with the backend, deep learning and edge teams so the platform keeps up with new products and models.
## What You Need to Be Successful
## Must have
• Python as a software engineer, not only for scripting. You will contribute to backend code every week.
• 5+ years building and operating production backend systems on a cloud platform. GCP preferred; deep AWS or Azure experience is fine.
• Hands-on production experience operating at least one stateful system under load: Kafka or another streaming platform, MySQL/PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. We mean partitioning, replication, lag, slow queries and failover, not only provisioning.
• Kubernetes in production, including scheduling, resource limits, autoscaling with KEDA, GPU node pools and debugging misbehaving pods.
• Debugging production incidents across layers (application, messaging, database, orchestration, network), with examples you can walk us through.
• Observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Grafana Mimir and Sentry, or equivalent: instrumenting code, writing useful alerts.
• Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool.
## Nice to have
• MySQL query tuning; Kafka internals (consumer group rebalancing, partition strategy, throughput tuning), Confluent Cloud and Kafka Connect.
• GPU workloads or ML inference serving in production (Ray/KubeRay or similar), and cloud cost optimization with measured results.
• Go, Snowflake, Airflow, CircleCI, Helm, and blue/green or canary releases.
## About you
• You take ownership of problems end to end and follow them into whichever layer they lead.
• You make decisions from data (profiles, metrics, query plans, cost reports) and prioritize well in startup/scaleup environments.
• Advanced written and spoken English.
• Comfortable coordinating across time zones with a global team.
• Comfortable with a shared on-call rotation.
## Why Focal Systems
Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.
Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.
Outstanding Partners - We work with some of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.
What we offerWe care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:
• Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
• Paid Time Off
• Team Retreats
• Education grants
Note: Our pay bands are driven by market benchmarks in the target geography for hiring. Our posted ranges typically include multiple job levels. A candidate's level is determined by their performance throughout our talent acquisition process including technical screens, behavior interviews, presentations, work samples, and references. We will communicate transparently with the candidate at final stages regarding how we have leveled them, and what salary range that places them into. Placement within range is equally determined by education, general experience in your profession, specific experience in our domain, and your performance in the talent acquisition process. It is rare to receive an offer at the top of the range for a role.

We’re looking for a skilled, self-driven Full-Stack Developer to build, maintain, and improve product features across both front-end and back-end systems.

• Participate in code reviews and uphold engineering standards.
• Follow collaborative development practices, including Git workflows and pull requests.

• Investigate, diagnose, and resolve issues across the technology stack.
• Prioritize fixes based on user needs and business impact.
• Support testing, deployment, and post-release monitoring.
## Technical Collaboration
• Work closely with engineers and stakeholders to scope requirements and evaluate technical tradeoffs.
• Communicate progress, raise blockers early, and ask clarifying questions when requirements are unclear.
• Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability and product quality.

• Proven experience as a Full-Stack Developer, with a track record of delivering production-ready features.

• Solid understanding of databases, RESTful API design, and system integration patterns.

• Ability to write clean, testable, and maintainable code.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues across the stack.
• Strong written English communication skills for working effectively with a distributed team.
• Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of deliverables.
## What Makes You a Strong Fit
• You can own a feature end-to-end, from initial implementation through deployment and monitoring.
• You communicate proactively, flag blockers early, and clarify requirements before making assumptions.
• You value code quality without allowing perfectionism to delay delivery unnecessarily.
• You approach code reviews as opportunities to collaborate and improve.
• You adapt to feedback, work well with others, and make thoughtful technical decisions.

• Product features are delivered on time and meet agreed requirements.
• Code is clean, tested, scalable, and maintainable.
• Bugs are investigated and resolved according to their impact.
• Technical risks and blockers are communicated early.
• Code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment are consistently part of the development process.
• The team can rely on you to take ownership and deliver with minimal supervision.
## Typical Day
Your day will focus on building and improving the product. You may start by reviewing open pull requests, then move into focused development work on a feature or bug fix. Throughout the day, you’ll communicate progress and blockers asynchronously, collaborate with teammates on technical decisions, and contribute to testing, deployments, and documentation.

## About the Role
We're looking for an Applied ML Engineer, Agents & Automation to design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that automate complex workflows across Bask Health's telehealth platform.
Bask Health brings together merchant operations, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools. Many of these processes involve multiple applications, structured information, business rules, and repetitive tasks. You'll help build AI-powered systems that can coordinate these steps while operating within clearly defined permissions and reliability requirements.
This role focuses on developing production AI agents that use large language models, application tools, retrieval systems, and workflow orchestration to complete approved tasks. You'll work on the technical infrastructure that allows agents to retrieve information, select appropriate tools, execute actions, handle failures, and maintain context throughout multi-step processes.
You'll combine applied machine learning with strong software engineering practices. Depending on the use case, this may involve model selection, fine-tuning, task-specific evaluation, or other machine learning techniques that improve agent performance. You'll also recognize when deterministic software and conventional automation are more reliable than model-driven decisions.
Your work may support merchant operations, internal administrative processes, patient-related coordination, and pharmacy workflows. You'll collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, applied AI engineers, and operational stakeholders to identify opportunities where automation can reduce manual work and improve consistency.
Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, agents must be designed with appropriate safeguards, access controls, auditability, and human approval requirements. You'll help ensure that automated systems operate within approved business and clinical boundaries and do not independently perform actions that require licensed professional judgment.
This is a hands-on engineering position with meaningful ownership over agent behavior, automation architecture, and production reliability. You'll build reusable systems, measure their performance, and improve them based on real-world results.
We're looking for someone who understands both the potential and limitations of AI agents and enjoys building systems that are useful, measurable, secure, and dependable.

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
## About the Role
We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Intern to join Bask Health's engineering team and gain practical experience developing machine learning models, working with real application data, and supporting production ML systems.
Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities. As we expand our machine learning capabilities, we're looking for motivated individuals who want to learn how intelligent systems are developed, evaluated, and integrated into real software products.
You'll work alongside experienced machine learning engineers, applied AI engineers, software engineers, and product teams to contribute to machine learning projects across the platform.
This internship is designed to provide hands-on engineering experience. Rather than focusing exclusively on theoretical research, you'll learn how machine learning models are developed, tested, improved, and prepared for use in production applications.
Your work may include preparing datasets, exploring model architectures, implementing training scripts, evaluating model performance, and helping integrate machine learning capabilities into existing software systems.
You'll gain exposure to practical machine learning workflows, including feature engineering, experiment tracking, model validation, performance monitoring, and reproducible development practices.
You'll also learn how engineering teams evaluate whether a machine learning solution is appropriate for a product problem, compare model approaches, and balance accuracy with reliability, latency, and operational cost.
You'll receive guidance from experienced engineers while contributing to appropriately scoped projects. As you develop your skills, you'll have opportunities to take greater ownership of technical tasks and communicate your findings to the team.
Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn how privacy, secure data handling, appropriate permissions, and human oversight affect machine learning development. You'll work with approved datasets and established safeguards, and your work will not involve independently making clinical decisions or determining patient treatment.
We welcome candidates who have developed machine learning skills through university coursework, independent projects, research, internships, hackathons, or self-directed learning. Previous professional machine learning engineering experience is not required.
We're looking for someone who enjoys programming, is curious about how machine learning systems work, and wants to develop the practical engineering skills needed to build reliable intelligent software.

You will study the brand's website and Instagram on your own, pick up its look and voice quickly, and get it right the first time. Constant rework costs time and AI generation credits, so a fast read on the brand matters. If you are fluent in AI video editing, have the tools you need, and can take a loose idea to a polished, on-brand video without hand-holding, this role is a strong fit.
## Why You'll Want to Join
• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
• Work on content for a globally recognized skincare brand with an active and growing Southeast Asian social media presence
• High-ownership creative role with real autonomy over concept, storyboard, and finished output
## What You'll Work On
## Creative Direction and Storyboarding
• Start from a script or outline for each video and develop it into a clear concept and storyboard
• Take a vague video concept and turn it into a finished video without waiting for detailed direction
• Storyboard from the brand's product and video catalog so every video is grounded in real products and existing brand assets
• Study the brand's website and Instagram on your own to understand its look, tone, and audience, and apply it correctly the first time
## AI Video Production
• Produce AI-driven short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other platforms in the style beauty and skincare brands are publishing now, matched to the brand's look
• Use AI video and image tools fluently across ideation, generation, editing, and finishing
• Cut, reformat, and enhance assets into finished, platform-ready content with motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound design
• Produce approximately 100 finished videos per month consistently and on schedule
• Do not use AI to generate human faces, skin, or realistic human imagery of any kind; all human and skin visuals must come from brand-provided assets
## Quality, Efficiency, and Self-Management
• Get the brand right the first time to avoid constant rework that burns time and AI generation credits
• Work with your own AI tools and platforms and keep your workflow current as new tools emerge
• Run your own projects with minimal supervision and flag asset gaps or brief issues early
• Organize files and deliver finished videos in the correct formats for each platform
## Requirements
## What You Bring
• Fluency in AI video editing and generation tools, with a portfolio of AI-driven short-form content
• Proven ability to take a vague concept and turn it into a finished, on-brand video
• Creative direction instincts including concepting, storyboarding, and the taste to make confident creative decisions
• Ability to study a brand's website and social presence and quickly absorb its look and voice
• Self-sufficiency: you need little training and do not need babysitting
• Your own AI tools and platforms, ready to use from day one
• Strong short-form editing skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar platforms
• Understanding of the limits on AI use, including no AI-generated human faces or skin
• Speed and efficiency at high volume without sacrificing quality
• Organized and reliable with consistent on-time delivery
• Available to work during Southeast Asia business hours
## Nice to Have
• Beauty, premium skincare, or makeup experience, since those candidates tend to know how to tell the story
• Experience creating AI content for beauty or consumer lifestyle brands
• Mandarin language skills for supporting Chinese-language content production
• Familiarity with Southeast Asian social media audiences and platform trends
• Experience with motion graphics or basic animation for social media content
• Background producing content for Instagram Reels or TikTok at scale
## How to Apply
## Please include:
• Your updated resume
• A portfolio link showing at least 4 to 6 finished AI-driven short-form videos, ideally in a beauty or premium consumer style
• A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your AI video workflow and tools, and walking through one video you took from a vague concept to a finished piece, including your storyboard and creative decisions
Shortlisted candidates will complete a short homework assignment: take a loosely defined video concept and turn it into a finished video.
Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.
If you are a self-sufficient creative who can turn a loose idea into an on-brand AI video without hand-holding, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.

## Application Process Overview
Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:
Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)

Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team
Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.
